facts.fact: 枪响时她把 Hoi 和 Jingling 一起按倒在地，翻查 Hoi 的头颅和胸口，没找到枪伤。
facts.anchor: Kiamling screamed, pulling Hoi and Jingling down to the ground.

facts.fact: 落叶半掩着一头大虎，Archie 把它打满了子弹；她跪在林地上的双腿被血浸湿。
facts.anchor: Partially camouflaged by the foliage was a huge tiger. Archie had plugged it full of bullets.

facts.fact: 她确认这不是影兽，是一头真的野兽；虎在岛上少见但并非没有，会游过海来猎食。
facts.anchor: Not the shadow beast; a real beast.

facts.fact: Archie 脸白如灰，手抖得左轮掉在地上，他蹲在枪边干呕。
facts.anchor: His hand shook so much the revolver fell to the ground, and he squatted beside it, dry-heaving.

facts.fact: 她断定 Archie 不会像别人那样拿虎皮当战利品去吹嘘；她挽着他的手臂扶他下山，扶得比必要的更久。
facts.anchor: Archie was not one of those.

facts.fact: Archie 说一切都解释得通了：从来没有影兽，一直就是一头虎。
facts.anchor: “This explains everything! There was never a shadow beast, it was a tiger all along,” Archie said.

facts.fact: 他喝了 mau toi 之后嘴唇回了点血色，手却还在抖；他说兰开斯特与总督听了会很高兴。
facts.anchor: but his hands continued to shake.

facts.fact: 她拿仙环、鬼马、Peake 秘书和街心长出的竹林反驳「一头虎」的解释。
facts.anchor: “Archie, this doesn’t explain the fae ring. The demon horses. Secretary Peake, and a bamboo forest springing up in the middle of a street!”

facts.fact: Archie 主张报警察，说出口时如释重负，觉得报了官自己那部分就了结了。
facts.anchor: “Yes, the police.” Archie was pleased with his pronouncement, a great weight lifted from him.

facts.fact: Jingling 的经络全堵死，气还在，只是一条条通道不通，要费大力气才能解开。
facts.anchor: Jingling’s meridian lines had been entirely blocked.

facts.fact: 她断定封住气的是影兽，并说影兽与鬼、尸不同：那些是喝气，影兽是止气、抹掉被袭者的记忆。
facts.anchor: It was the shadow beast, it had to be.

facts.fact: Hoi 说英国人唯一的职责是把金银运回伦敦，其余都是借口，是把猪打扮好再割喉。
facts.anchor: “The only duty they have is to the chests of gold and silver they’re taking back to London.

facts.fact: Archie 说香港是英国殖民地，他们没有理由害它，只想把繁荣带给所有人。
facts.anchor: “Hong Kong is a British colony, why would we do it any harm? We want to bring prosperity to everyone.”

facts.fact: 被问鸦片生意与他所指责的有何不同，Hoi 只答「需要就是理由」。
facts.anchor: “Needs must.”

facts.fact: Hoi 说不信 Archie，但补了一句他信她。
facts.anchor: “I don’t,” Hoi said, then added gruffly, “but I trust you.”

facts.fact: 她一个个通开 Jingling 身上的堵点，经络重新流动，妹妹的呼吸从嘶哑转为平顺，只需休息。
facts.anchor: The meridian channels flowed again, golden as nectar.

facts.fact: 她睡醒后发现两个男人没有互相撕打，而是在打牌，像达成了某种停战。
facts.anchor: They seemed to have come to some sort of truce.

facts.fact: 她承认气是有限的，几天没把气池填满，等于拿自己的寿数在烧。
facts.anchor: Qi was finite, and scraping for the dregs at the bottom of the well merely meant she was burning through years of her own life.

facts.fact: 她答应去警察局，一半是给 Archie 的安慰奖，一半因为他没说错，她该开始求人帮忙。
facts.anchor: “We’ll go to the police,” she said. A consolation prize for Archie.

facts.fact: 她追问 Thaumaturgy Society 是什么，他只交代在 King's College 跟社团同学学会了开枪。
facts.anchor: “Thauma… what?”
